title: From a Round 37 Pick to a $503 Million Deal
description:
Baseball drafted him in round 37. Football signed him for up to 503 million dollars.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Patrick Mahomes: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patrick_Mahomes

From Wikipedia (Patrick Mahomes): the Detroit Tigers selected him in the 37th round of the 2014 MLB draft and he did not sign; the Kansas City Chiefs selected him 10th overall in the 2017 NFL draft and he spent his rookie season as the backup; on July 6, 2020 he signed a ten-year extension worth $477 million with an additional $26 million in potential bonuses ($503 million in total), at the time the largest contract in professional sports history; he has won three Super Bowls and three Super Bowl MVPs. Not financial advice.

cta: Football or baseball? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: Baseball drafted him in round 37. Football signed him for up to 503 million dollars.
He never signed. He picked football instead.
Then the Chiefs took him 10th. But year one, he was the backup.
Then a ten-year deal. The largest in pro sports at the time.
And he's won three Super Bowls. Just so far.
